CI Bot: :rotating_light: Nightly perf alert: tail latency (p95/p99) drifted upward across prod-us/prod-eu at 00:12 UTC. Dashboard: https://dash.internal/nightly/alerts/1755559000 CI run: https://ci.internal/runs/9842 Merge: PR#3421 landed ~23:50 UTC

Asha (perf): seeing the same. Alert window aligns with PR#3421 (kernel selector tweak + batching heuristic). p99 up ~40% on heavy-chat workloads.

Kai: I spun up a staging repro with the exact config from the canary. Quick note: when batching.window_ms increases past ~20ms we trigger a different kernel path for certain attention sizes. Observed p99 jump locally.

Marco: which kernel path? commit hash for the selector change?

Asha (perf): selector change is commit abcdef2 (optimize selector epsilon and prober ordering). Kernel chosen more aggressively: `fused_attention_v2` vs `fast_matmul` for sequences ~512. Profiler shows increased cache churn and longer kernel setup time. Snippet from a short perf dump:

```
# lightweight trace sample (staging, 1000 reqs)
kernel_choice:fused_attention_v2 -> 23% time
kernel_choice:fast_matmul -> 12% time
kv_evictions/sec: 540 -> 1830
batching.window_ms: 12 -> 38
avg_kv_lookup_latency_ms: 0.9 -> 2.7
# tail latency correlates with eviction spikes
```

Kai: sounds like a coupling between batching expansion and kernel prober leads to KV cache thrash (more unique contexts in a batch, larger memory working set). The selector favors a kernel with higher setup overhead that loses when the KV working set increases.

Ryan (SRE): Canary telemetry shows ~5% of canary hosts crossed the degrade threshold; rolling was not yet completed but we should pause and mitigate. Can we flip a config toggle to force the previous selector before full revert? :eyes:

Marco: I can open a revert to unblock rollout. Short-term mitigation: gate the new selector behind a feature flag and lower batching.window_ms on canary. I’ll prepare PRs: revert PR#3450 + config patch.

Asha (perf): ack. Revert is safest right now to restore SLOs. Also want a follow-up bisect to tease apart whether selector epsilon or prober ordering is dominant. I'll run a controlled microbench on both dims.

Marco: opened revert PR #3450: https://git.internal/r/PR/3450 — rolling back selector change. Also opened config patch PR #3451 to set batching.window_ms=12 for canaries.

CI Bot: Revert PR #3450 triggered nightly smoke CI: https://ci.internal/runs/9860 (smoke builds + perf quickcheck).

Ryan (SRE): I'll pause the canary rollout and pin the canary hosts to the previous image. Watching dashboards; lowered alert thresholds to catch any remaining noise.

Kai: I'll start the bisect tomorrow morning with a small harness: toggle epsilon, toggle prober ordering, and sweep batching.window_ms={8,12,20,32}. Will post results here.

Asha (perf): thanks — once we have microbench numbers we can propose a safer selector policy (maybe cost-model + working-set signal). For now revert + config patch should return tail latency to baseline.

Marco: closing loop: revert & config patches merged to canary branch. Will monitor for the next 2 hours and escalate if any hosts still show degradation. Will upload full perf traces and the bisect plan to the eng-runtime confluence page.

Ryan (SRE): noted. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:

Asha (perf): will follow up with bisect artifacts and a recommended rollout plan in this thread.
